scope: Source-grounded utility eligibility and ordered task-specific fallback, plus exact-instance utility selection; custom model CRUD/options/vendor groups deferred.
implementation: Shared pure resolver used by MainWindow configureUtilities and turnAboutToStart compression setup. Complete title/compression candidate chains preserve exact provider instance, order, explicit per-entry thinking overrides and discovered/configured context limits.

External-only presets with empty/fully-excluded overrides use configured global utilities; mixed/native presets use their eligible chat chain. Missing provider counts eligible before resolution, then skips, so an intentional missing override never silently switches to global.

Empty utility chain tries current active selection first then preset models; compression additionally has final active-model fallback; title nonempty configured chain without preset does not append current model. Legacy native top-level-only preset primary remains supported.

Codex/OpenCode/Claude removed only from new utility choices and defensively skipped by UtilityService. Main/fallback chat selection unchanged; stored external/missing/disabled rows remain visible and preserved.
Guarded QInputDialog preserves selected row identity rather than indexOf(displayText); per-item exact-instance tooltip/data added. Owner deletion/cancel and preferences CAS conflict covered.

failures: Actual /compact on Codex external-only preset made zero configured HTTP requests
Actual fake-Codex chat title path made zero configured HTTP requests
Second identically labeled provider selection saved first instance
before.fixtureNotes: Initial seed omitted legacy preset primary fields and was corrected before the retained host-before reproduction. Later pure matrix fixture used same-object QJsonValueRef assignment; corrected to owned .value(). Neither is represented as a production defect.

verification.network: Loopback fixtures only; fake harness subprocess only, no credentials/live services.
verification.settingsCompatibility: Standalone targets compiled with new helper; explicit offscreen static plugin imports were private harness setup only. Initial unlogged startup process was stopped by exact private executable identity, then both suites passed.

patch.authoritative: Listed src/ and tests/ paths under this stage. next/ is initial draft-only and must not be copied.
seams: MainWindow.cpp include + turnAboutToStart compression setup + configureUtilities only; constructor/send/side-chat links untouched
SettingsPage.cpp new guarded picker and utility/preset-chain sections only; unrelated settings unchanged
UtilityService.cpp candidate exclusion only; protocol/request/retry/cancellation code unchanged
Root UI_SOURCES glob adds helper; standalone Settings targets require helper explicitly. No production CMake patch included.

renders.conclusion: New status text wraps and controls remain visible at requested column widths. These are actual Settings content columns; fixed-width full Settings navigation is excluded from narrow rendering, so no full-window350px or exact screenshot parity claim.

limits: Private integration only; parent full combined gate pending.
No custom-model CRUD, generic provider options, rich vendor groups, Stagewise built-in alias fallback/default utility models, or new thinking-editor controls.
Native existing per-model typed override schema retained; source-wide model-thinking/custom option migration is deferred.
External automatic context compression remains delegated to its managed harness; this change enables configured native manual utilities and correct HTTP utility selection.
No universal bug-free/full Stagewise parity claim.
